about: SerpAPI finds nothing: the response has no organic_results field

connector.none: no captured search connector; the Claude side serves the same responses through its HTTP mock

reads.note: HTTP Request v4.2 GET https://serpapi.com/search?q=<chunk>&api_key=<…>&engine=google, once per chunk through Split Data for SerpAPI Batching. The api_key value is the expression $credentials.SerpAPI.key; n8n 2.47.7 resolves it without an error and sends the request (canned check, R4e 2026-11-16), so the run goes on to Format SerpAPI Organic Results. The query is model-written, so one result list answers every chunk

branches: Format SerpAPI Organic Results reads organic_results.length on a missing field and fails (or returns its 'No search results found.' item)
expect.offline: Search queries, extracted contexts and the report are model-driven (n8n's replies are recorded); the only effect is the chat reply. n8n 2.47.7 resolves the template's $credentials expression in the api_key parameter without an error and sends Perform SerpAPI Search Request, so its baseline runs past it: normal and hostile succeed, empty stops at Format SerpAPI Organic Results and malformed at the Jina requests, as their branches say (canned check, R4e 2026-11-16). Both memory buffers share the custom session key my_test_session
